name: smwgraphics-the-mucus-flow-interior
title: The Mucus Flow - Interior
description:
A set of high tech architectural tilesets created for The Mucus Flow, a rom hack by SF - The Dark Warrior for Romhack Races, which itself was based on the Doom WAD of the same name.

Credit is appreciated. Please acknowledge The Dark Warrior and his rom hack as well while you're at it!

The submission also includes an On/Off door, gate, and warp zone that should use custom blocks to properly work.
